findings.title: Legacy url always labelled JSONRPC transport
findings.problem: _normalize_legacy_url synthesises {transport: JSONRPC} for any legacy card with a url, ignoring a legacy preferredTransport (GRPC / HTTP+JSON) and additionalInterfaces, which are dropped.
findings.impact: A v0.3 card whose primary transport is not JSON-RPC is mislabelled and calls are sent with the wrong protocol to that endpoint. Reachability of such stored cards was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Read data.get('preferredTransport') (default JSONRPC) and synthesise the interface only when it is JSONRPC (case-insensitive), or carry the declared transport through; preserve additionalInterfaces where they map to supportedInterfaces.

findings.title: Typed interface error escapes handler constructor
findings.problem: A2AAssistantHandler.__init__ builds RemoteAgentConnections -> A2AClient, whose __init__ calls get_jsonrpc_url and raises AgentCardInterfaceError before process_request runs. The 400 mapping at line 1369 is therefore never reached for a card lacking a JSON-RPC interface. The test passes only because it patches RemoteAgentConnections.
findings.impact: An unusable stored or remote card still surfaces as a bare ValueError (500) instead of the documented 400, so the R3/AC5 requirement is unmet in production.
findings.recommendation: Map AgentCardInterfaceError to ExtendedHTTPException 400 at the construction site (in __init__ or where the handler is created), or in A2AClient callers; add a test constructing the handler without patching RemoteAgentConnections.
